name: Coveo Solutions Inc.
summary: Coveo Solutions Inc. provides software-as-a-service artificial intelligence (AI) platform in Canada, the United States, and internationally. The company offers Coveo AI-Relevance Platform that powers search, recommendations, and generative AI, and agentic experiences across commerce, customer service, website, and workplace applications. Its AI-Relevance platform includes Coveo Relevance Generative Answering (CRGA) capability integrates large language models technology with Coveo's platform to feed generative AI with a common, secure unified index, and real-time content.
